content: Bhana bhasu, jing'umbu ja mu mutima gwani na lisabhwa lwani ku Nyamuanga ni ingulu yebhwe, ingulu yo mwelulo gwebhwe.
Kulwo kubha enibhabhambalila ati bhekomesishe ingulu ya Nyamuanga, mbe nawe atali ingulu yo bhumenyi.
Kulwo kubha bhatabhumenya obhulengelesi bhwa Nyamuanga, na abhaiga okumbaka obhulengelesi bhwebhwe abhene. Bhaliga bhatolobhele mu bhulengelesi bhwa Nyamuanga.
Kulwo kubha Kristo niwe bhukumisha bhe bhilagilo ingulu yo bhulengelesi bhwa bhuli munu unu kekilisha.
Kwo kubha Musa kandika okulubhana no bhulengelesi bhunu obhuja okulubhana ne bhilagilo: Omunu unu Kenda okukola obhulengelesi bhwe bhilagilo kekala kwo bhulengelesi bhunu.”
Mbe nawe obhulengelesi bhunu obhulubhana ne likilisha elyaika kutya, “Wasiga kwaika mu mwoyo gwao ati, “Niga unu akalinye mu Lwile? (Gunu nikumutelemusha Kristo emwalo)'”.
Na Wasiga kwaika ati, 'Niga unu akeke mulyobho?'” (Gunu nikumulinya Kristo ingulu okusoka mu bhafuye).
Mbe nawe eyaikaki? “omusngo guli ayei nawe, mukanwa yao na mu mwoyo gwao.” Ogwo ni musango gwe likilisha, gunu eswe echilasha.
Kulwo kubha alabha kwo munwa gwao oumwikilisha Yesu ati ni Latabhugenyi, no ku mwikilisha mumwoyo gwao ati Nyamuanga amusulue okusoka mu bhafue, owelulwa.
Kwo kubha kwo omwoyo omunu kekilisha no kubhona obhulengelesi, na kwo munwa omwikilisha no kubhona okwelulwa.
Kwo kubha elyandiko elyaika,”bhuli unu kamwikilisha ataliswala.”
Kwo kubha bhutalio bhutasikane agati ya Bhayaudi na Bhayunani. kwo kubha Latabhugenyi ulya ulya ni wabhona, na ni munibhi kubhona ku bhanu abhanu abhamubhilikila.
Kwo kubha bhuli munu unu kalibhilikila lisina Lya Latabhugenyi alikisibhwa.

Ku nsongaki abhatula okumubhilikila omwene oyo bhachali kumwikilisha? Na Kulwaki abhatula okumwikilisha omwene oyo bhachali kumungwa? Na abhongwa atiki bhatalasibhwe omusango, atali bhatumilwe? -Kutyo jandikilwe,”
Nikutiki abhatula okusimula, atali bhatumilwe? - Lwa kutyo jandikilwe, “Nikutiki nigakisi amagulu gebhwe bhalya bhanu abhalasha emisango ne jo bhukondelewe ne emisango je kisi
Mbe nawe bhone bhatagutegelesishe omusango gwo bhwana, kwo kubha Isaya aikile “Latabhugenyi, niga unu oguwe omusango gweswe?”
Kwibhyo okwikilisha okuja okulubhana no kungwa, no kungwa kwo Musango gwa Kristo.
Mcbe nawe naika,” Angu bhatonguwe?” Yee kwe chimali muno. “Obhulaka bhwebhwe bhwaulukile anja muchalo chone, ne misango jebhwe okuja kubhutelo bhwe chalo.”

Kubhutelo bhwa gone, enaika,”Angu Israeli atamenyele? “Musa niwe ambile okwaika,”Nilibhasolosoja okubhayana lifuwa ku bhanu abho bhatali bheyanga. Kujila ya liyanga elyo litali nabhumenyi, Nilibhasolosoja mubhiililwe.”
Mbe Isaya Ali no bhubhasi muno kaika, “Na bhonekene na bhalia abho bhatanyingile. Nabhonekene kubhalia abho bhatankenele.”
Mbe nawe kwa Israel kaika,” Naku jona nenamusishe amabhoko gani kwabho bhatonguwe na ku bhanu bhakomee.”
